facts.fact: Youm7 reports that the Ministry of Justice and MCIT remote power-of-attorney service verifies applicants' identity with AI techniques, matching a face scan against state biometric records.
facts.system: Remote general power-of-attorney service (Digital Egypt platform)

facts.fact: Youm7 reports that the Ministry of Justice and MCIT remote power-of-attorney service verifies a citizen by face scan against state biometric records, then issues a one-time remote e-signature certificate per transaction, on ITIDA-built infrastructure.
facts.system: Remote e-signature and identity verification for the power-of-attorney service

facts.fact: Youm7 reports that applicants move from the Digital Egypt platform to the digital identity app to prove their identity and obtain a remote e-signature certificate for the power-of-attorney service run by the state.
